d: Long, straight jet-black hair falls past the shoulders with blunt-cut bangs and a small bun atop the head. Sharp, almond-shaped neon-green eyes set on a youthful face with a neutral expression. A slender build wearing a white sleeveless top with a black bow, a short pleated black skirt, black thigh-high stockings, and black Mary Jane shoes, all layered under a wide-sleeved black oversized robe with blue accents. Small, glowing neon-blue horns protrude from the forehead, and the figure holds a white folding fan with blue floral patterns.
